title: Integer multiplicity of a current given by an integer chart-oriented n-vector density (parent Steps 7, 8, 10, 11)
statement: Assume (WTC) [the frozen statement of lpf_weighted_tangent_on_c1_chart]: if V ⊆ ℝ^Q is open, M ⊆ V is Hⁿ-null-measurable, θ > 0 on M and θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ V, and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q is C¹ and antilipschitz on an open Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ, then for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ Φ(Ω))-a.e. y and every w ∈ Ω with Φ(w) = y, HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y (range DΦ(w)); and assume (SNA) [the frozen statement of the uncle lemma lpf_simple_nvector_algebra]: for all P, n and v : Fin n → ℝ^P, ‖simpleNVector v‖² = det(⟨v_i, v_j⟩)_{i,j}; and for all P, n, every real n×n matrix B and τ : Fin n → ℝ^P, simpleNVector(i ↦ Σ_j B_ij τ_j) = det(B) • simpleNVector τ. Let Q, n ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^Q open, and G_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q C¹ maps with O_k ⊆ ℝⁿ open, G_k c_k-antilipschitz on O_k for some c_k > 0 (k ∈ ℕ). Let Y ⊆ V be Hⁿ-null-measurable with Hⁿ(Y ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ V. Let Ψ : ℝ^Q → NVector(ℝ^Q, n) be Hⁿ⌞Y-a.e. strongly measurable, with ‖Ψ‖ Hⁿ-integrable on Y ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ V. Assume that for Hⁿ⌞Y-a.e. y, there are m ∈ ℕ, integers a_1,…,a_m, indices k_1,…,k_m ∈ ℕ, points w_i ∈ O_{k_i} with G_{k_i}(w_i) = y, and orthonormal σ_i : Fin n → ℝ^Q with span(range σ_i) = range DG_{k_i}(w_i) (i = 1,…,m), such that Ψ(y) = Σ_i a_i • simpleNVector σ_i. If S ∈ D_n(V) satisfies S(ω) = ∫_Y Ψ(y)(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(V), then S is an integer multiplicity current (IsIntegerMultiplicity S).
